page.overview:
What is Enoa Academy?

The Cefran Zaibatsu is a owned, presumably, by the Cefran Family.

The daughter of the zaibatsu's head was introduced to Prince Reuven of the Esperia Kingdom, seemingly for the purpose of establishing a political marriage.

Nearly a century ago, the head of the Cefran Zaibatsu had a daughter. He sent her to enroll in , where she graduated top of her class.

About 80 years ago, the head's daughter was introduced to Prince Reuven in the Esperia Kingdom, though he had no interest in her.
